## Purpose and Entry Points
Agent Reach is a Python 3.10+ local capability layer for AI agents: it selects, installs, diagnoses, and documents access paths to web, search, social, video, RSS, and developer platforms. It does not proxy content retrieval; agents invoke the selected upstream CLI, MCP server, or HTTP service directly. Primary entry point: `agent_reach/cli.py`; orchestration and public operations reside in `agent_reach/core.py`.

## CLI Lifecycle and System Boundary
The CLI exposes install, configure, doctor, probe, skill, and uninstall-style workflows. Installation is intentionally read-only by default; system dependency installation, MCP registration, and skill-file writes require explicit authorization. Environment classification and operational checks are separated into `agent_reach/core.py`, `agent_reach/doctor.py`, and `agent_reach/probe.py`. Process execution is centralized behind `agent_reach/utils/process.py`, an important boundary for external command invocation.

## Channel Registry and Routing
Channels are registered centrally in `agent_reach/channels/__init__.py` and conform to shared contracts in `agent_reach/channels/base.py`. Each channel represents a platform and contains an ordered set of candidate backends; probing selects the first genuinely usable route and reports remediation for failures. Representative implementations: `agent_reach/channels/twitter.py`, `agent_reach/channels/bilibili.py`, and `agent_reach/channels/xiaohongshu.py`. This isolates platform churn to individual channel modules rather than core workflow changes.

## External Backends and Services
The runtime composes external tools rather than implementing scrapers: Jina Reader for web content, yt-dlp for YouTube, GitHub `gh`, feedparser, bili-cli, Twitter/Reddit CLIs, and OpenCLI browser-session access. Exa semantic search is reached through mcporter, with backend-specific integration in `agent_reach/backends/opencli.py` and `agent_reach/channels/exa_search.py`. LinkedIn and other MCP-backed routes are represented in channel modules such as `agent_reach/channels/linkedin.py`.

## Credentials, Local State, and Security
Configuration and credentials are local-machine concerns managed by `agent_reach/config.py`; cookie acquisition has a dedicated boundary in `agent_reach/cookie_extract.py`. Path isolation is centralized in `agent_reach/utils/paths.py`. The architecture distinguishes manually exported cookies from reuse of an existing, user-controlled browser session, especially for OpenCLI-backed channels. No repository component is described as uploading credentials.

## Agent-Facing Skill Distribution
The package ships operational instructions for agent runtimes, rather than a service API. Canonical skill content is in `agent_reach/skill/SKILL.md` and `agent_reach/skill/SKILL_en.md`, with domain references under `agent_reach/skill/references/`. Core installation can register these instructions into supported agent skill locations, allowing an agent to select and execute upstream commands.

## Specialized Media and MCP Surfaces
Podcast transcription is a distinct optional flow: `agent_reach/transcribe.py` invokes supporting setup/script material, including `agent_reach/scripts/transcribe_xiaoyuzhou.sh`. MCP exposure is available through `agent_reach/integrations/mcp_server.py`, while mcporter configuration is represented by `config/mcporter.json`. These extend the local CLI capability layer into agent/MCP ecosystems without making the project a hosted web application.
